paragraphs: 🌐 Live Website: 📡 Production REST API: 🤖 AI Review Engine: Google Gemini (gemini-3.8-flash) 📊 ML Defect Inference: FastAPI + Scikit-Learn

CodeSense AI is a production-grade developer platform that combines deterministic AST static code analysis, supervised machine learning defect-risk estimation, and LLM-grounded explanations to review GitHub pull requests in real time.
MongoDB was chosen over relational databases because pull request code reviews possess dynamic, document-oriented structures:
features: Hierarchical Review Findings: Findings have variable metadata, code snippets, diff hunks, and multi-line explanations naturally suited for JSON documents.
Schema Flexibility Across Analyzer Versions: As new static rules and ML versions are introduced, document schemas evolve without migration downtime.
Compound Indexing & Fast Retrieval: Single-query retrieval for complex PR reports with nested risk assessments and severity counts.

requirements.text: Zero-Login Public PR Analysis: Paste any public GitHub pull request URL (e.g. facebook/react#28000) and initiate analysis immediately.
GITHUBTOKEN: (Optional) GitHub Personal Access Token to avoid unauthenticated rate limits (60/hr -> 5,000/hr).
OPENAIAPIKEY: (Optional) OpenAI API key for LLM explanations and chat assistant.
